title: geranium nepalense f. pallidum
intro: Geranium nepalense f. pallidum, commonly known as the Himalayan geranium, is a plant species in the Geraniaceae family that is native to the Himalayan region. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include its ability to provide relief from stress and anxiety, improve sleep quality, and alleviate symptoms of menstrual cramps and menopausal hot flashes. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its sedative and anti-inflammatory properties, as well as its ability to regulate hormonal imbalances. The bioactive constituents of Geranium nepalense f. pallidum include flavonoids, terpenoids, and saponins, which have been shown to possess antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-cancer properties.
